confirmed.title: Quoted empty plugin command arguments disappear and shift later positional placeholders
confirmed.contract: Module advertises quoted positional/named argument expansion; its tokenizer explicitly recognizes single/double quoted tokens. Preserving an explicitly empty quoted token is inferred from this supported token grammar, rather than from a separately executed upstream Codex implementation.
confirmed.trigger: A command body uses $1/$2/$3 and the user supplies an empty quoted argument before a later nonempty positional token, e.g. "" next last or left '' right.
confirmed.observed: The empty token is discarded: the first example produces one=<next> two=<last> three=<> while $ARGUMENTS still contains the original raw input.
confirmed.control: Nonempty quoted token with spaces, named empty FILE="", absent positional token, ordinary named placeholders and raw argument alias remain supported.
confirmed.evidenceLevel: real pure production expander; real Codex command copier with owned temporary input/output; host propagation inspected statically
confirmed.limits: No installed plugin scan, command host/IPC/UI, Engine/model, shell, plugin installation or upstream Codex runtime executed. Both single/double quoted manifestations are one tokenizer root cause.

confirmed.title: All-arguments placeholder consumes prefixes of complete named plugin placeholders
confirmed.contract: Named argument assignments and named placeholders use [A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*. Existing tests explicitly require unknown environment-like placeholders to remain unchanged. ARGUMENTS_FILE is a named key accepted by this module grammar; ARGUMENTS_UNKNOWN tests the independent unknown-literal preservation contract.
confirmed.trigger: Command body contains $ARGUMENTS_FILE with raw ARGUMENTS_FILE=src/example.ts, or contains an unassigned $ARGUMENTS_UNKNOWN.
confirmed.observed: The earlier $ARGUMENTS alternative matches a prefix: file=ARGUMENTS_FILE=src/example.ts_FILE and untouched=ARGUMENTS_FILE=src/example.ts_UNKNOWN. Neither a complete named value substitution nor preservation of the unknown token occurs.
confirmed.control: $FILE substitutes, $UNKNOWN stays literal, exact $ARGUMENTS/{args} receive raw input, and placeholder-like text in a named argument is not re-expanded.
confirmed.evidenceLevel: real pure production expander and real temporary command conversion; static host propagation only
confirmed.limits: No model prompt submission or host command execution. Known-name and unknown-name manifestations share the same missing token boundary and count once. No external Codex compatibility assertion is required.

confirmed.title: Accepted Windows marketplace paths derive names that the next metadata guard rejects
confirmed.contract: parseMarketplaceInput explicitly supports drive-prefixed paths with either slash style, and deriveMarketplaceName takes the last repository path segment for the persisted marketplace name.
confirmed.trigger: User supplies C:\work\skills.git through ordinary marketplace add input.
confirmed.observed: Parsing accepts the source but derives \work\skills instead of skills. The real assertSafePluginName used by marketplaceDir rejects that name.
confirmed.control: C:/work/skills.git, /tmp/skills.git, owner/Skills and HTTPS Skills.git all derive skills and pass the same guard.
confirmed.evidenceLevel: real pure parser→deriver→same production name validator, run on macOS; add callers inspected statically
confirmed.limits: No Windows-native filesystem or Git/clone/install/addMarketplace execution. Source shows Desktop/TUI pass the derived name unchanged to addMarketplace, whose first statement obtains marketplaceDir and calls this guard before clone. Forward slashes provide a workaround.
